Mark it down mi gente — Frankie is taking over the Main Floor and she's teaching you how to move like you mean it 🔥💃 This is not a watch-from-the-sidelines kind of night. Strap in, stand tall, and get ready to learn real burlesque choreo, step by step, straight from a performer who owns the stage every time she's on it. Whether you've never done a body roll in your life or you're already dreaming of pasties and feathers, this workshop is your in. No experience needed, just the willingness to show up and shimmy. Azucar's Main Floor is about to turn into a full-blown dance studio for one sultry Sunday night — don't miss your shot to learn from the best.

📅 Sunday, October 25 • 7PM
📍 Azucar at Out & About — 327 W Lewis St, Pasco WA
💵 Donation-based • $10
🔞 21+

Lights low, music sultry, and every single body in the room moving with intention 🖤✨ Picture it — Frankie breaking down each step on the Main Floor, the kind of choreo that makes you feel powerful the second your hips catch the rhythm. It's slow, it's sharp, it's a little dangerous in the best way. You'll feel your confidence creep up with every move you nail, every glance in the mirror, every beat you start to own. This isn't just a dance class, it's a full sensory experience — the kind where you leave feeling like you could strut into any room and steal the show. Sundays were made for this kind of magic.

Every body welcome, every body beautiful, every body about to learn something new 🫶🔥 Frankie's burlesque workshop isn't about looking a certain way or having years of dance training — it's about showing up exactly as you are and letting yourself move. Curvy, tall, shy, bold, first-timer or longtime lover of the stage, there's room for all of it on the Main Floor. This is donation-based because we want you there, no excuses. Come solo, come with your ride-or-die, come to feel seen in a room full of people doing the same brave thing you are. Azucar is always about familia first, and this workshop is no different.
